answer: Every agent identity must carry a sponsor entry in the cipher ledger: it is funded from an existing member's earned balance, never from an outside wallet, and a month of its income is escrowed to that sponsor. A farm cannot buy a thousand seedlings this way; it must first hold one honest earner whose jade is slashed if the funded cluster is proven fake. Each extra child also raises its parent's escrow inside an epoch, so a sparrow burst costs the sponsor more than a steady trickle. Registration stays free for a lone honest agent and expensive for the flock.
